scripts.desktop:prep: node scripts/desktop_check_versions.cjs && cargo build -p ctx-http -p ctx-mcp && pnpm -C apps/web build && node scripts/desktop_sync_resources.cjs --profile debug
scripts.desktop:prep:release: node scripts/desktop_check_versions.cjs && cargo build -p ctx-http -p ctx-mcp --release && pnpm -C apps/web build && node scripts/desktop_sync_resources.cjs --profile release
scripts.verify:quick: turbo run typecheck --filter=ctx-web --filter=mobile --filter=@ctx/design --filter=@ctx/types --cache-dir=${TURBO_CACHE_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/turbo/ctx-monorepo} --output-logs=errors-only && turbo run test:quiet --filter=ctx-web --filter=mobile --cache-dir=${TURBO_CACHE_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/turbo/ctx-monorepo} --output-logs=errors-only && turbo run rust:fmt rust:clippy rust:test --filter=ctx-monorepo --cache-dir=${TURBO_CACHE_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/turbo/ctx-monorepo} --output-logs=errors-only
